content: Koht ketin Keriahla Dikedik en Eni kan
Ekei kaunen mehn Israel ko ahpw patohdo rehi pwe re en ale kaweid duwen kupwur en KAUN-O.
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong ie,

“Kowe, nein aramas, ohl pwukat pangalahr mohngiongirail kan ong dikedik en eni kan oh mweidalahr pwe dikedik en eni kan en kahrehiong irail nan dihp. Ke lemeleme me I pahn kak kasalehiong irail ei pasapeng?

“Eri, lokaiaiong irail oh padahkihong irail dahme ngehi, KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, ketin mahmahsanihong irail: Mehn Israel men me pangalahr eh mohngiong ong dekedik en eni kan oh kahrehiong ih nan dihp, e ahpw pahn kohdo pwehn ale kaweid rehn soukohp men, pahn ale pasapeng sang rehi—pasapeng me konehng nah dikedik en eni ngeder kan!
Dikedik en eni pwuko koaros kahredahr mehn Israel kan ar sohpeisang ie, ahpw sang nan ei pasapeng I koapworopworki me I pahn kapwureiraildohng nan ar loalopwoat.
“Eri met, ndaiong mehn Israel kan dahme ngehi, KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, ketin mahmahsanih: Kumwail pwurodo oh kesehla noumwail dikedik en eni saut kan.

“Ni ahnsou me emen mehn Israel kan de emen mehn liki kan me koukousoan rehn mehn Israel kan pahn sohpeisang ie oh pwongih dikedik en eni kan, oh mwuhr e ahpw kohla pwehn ale kaweid rehn soukohp men, ngehi, KAUN-O, me pahn kihong ei pasapeng!
I pahn uhwong. I pahn wiahkihla ih mehn karasepe ehu. I pahn katohrehsang ih nanpwungen nei aramas akan, pwe kumwail en esehla me ngehi, KAUN-O.
“Ma soukohp men pahn wiahda kokohp likamw, met pwehki ngehi, KAUN-O, me kupwurehda en wiahda kokohp likamw. I pahn katohrehsang rehn mehn Israel kan.
Soukohpo oh mehmeno me ale kaweid sang reh pahn ale soangen kalokolok teieu.
I pahn wia met pwehn kolokol mehn Israel kan pwe re dehr sohpeisang ie oh kasaminehkihla pein irail diparail kan. Iei irail nei aramas, oh ngehi me ar Koht.” KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, me mahmahsen.”
Noha, Danel, oh Sohp
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong ie,
“Kowe, nein aramas, ma wehi ehu pahn wiahda dihp oh soaloalopwoatohng ie, I pahn kapahla limei oh kamwomwala eh wahnsahpw akan. I pahn kadarodo lehk lapalap oh kemehla aramas oh mahn akan.
Mehnda ma ohl silimeno, Noha, Danel,
oh Sohp, iang koukousoan wasao, ar lelepek pahn doarehlahte pein ar mour.” KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, me mahmahsen.
“De I pahn kadarodo mahn lawalo pwehn kemehla aramas akan me kahredahr sahpwo eh keperlahr oh solahr me kak seiloak kotehla sahpwo,

oh pil mehnda ma ohl silimeno koukousoan wasao—nin duwen ngehi, KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, Koht ieias emen—re sohte pahn pil kak doarehla pein nair seri kan. Re pahn doarehlahte pein irail, oh sahpwo pahn wiahla sapwtehn ehu.
“De I pahn kadarodo mahwen pohn sahpwo oh kadarodo tehtehn mahwen kehlail pwehn koakoahsang aramas akan oh mahn akan,
oh pil mehnda ma ohl silimeno koukousoan wasao—nin duwen ngehi, KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, Koht ieias emen—re sohte pahn pil kak doarehla pein nair seri kan, ahpw arail mour kelehpw.
“Ma I pahn kadarodo soumwahu lusulus pohn sahpwo oh kihsang mour en me ngeder nan ei engieng, kemehla aramas oh mahn akan,

mehnda ma Noha, Danel, oh Sohp koukousoan wasao—I kahukihla nin duwen ngehi, KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, Koht ieias emen—re sohte pahn kak en doarehla pein nair seri kan. Arail lelepek pahn doarehla pein ar mour kelehpw.”

Iei met me KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, ketin mahmahsanih: “I pahn kadarodo ei kalokolok keieu suwed pahieu pohn Serusalem— mahwen, lehk lapalap, mahn lawalo, oh soumwahu—pwehn kemehla aramas oh mahn koaros.
Ma mehmen pahn pitla oh doarehla nah seri, tehk mwomwarail ni ar pahn pwarodo rehmwail. Tehk mwomwen ar suwed, oh kumwail en esehla me kalokolok me I pahn ketikidohng pohn Serusalem me pwung;
kumwail eri pahn esehla me mie kahrepe mwahu ehu me kahredahr ei wiahda soahng pwukat koaros.” KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, me mahmahsen.

footnotes.text: DANEL: De Daniel (tehk 28.3), ohl ndand men, me aramas akan pil wehwehki duwen eh mour poadidi.
